AArch64 instruction encoders (integer core). Mirrors dynasm-rs plugin/src/arch/aarch64/opmap.rs bases + compiler.rs command semantics, and runtime/src/aarch64.rs immediate helpers. Fixed 32-bit little-endian words; PC-relative relocations use the arch-specific codes in relocations.nim (B/BCOND/ADR/ADRP/TBZ).

Imports

types, relocations, registers

proc a64BfmI(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd, rn: Register; amt: int64;
             is64: bool; op: int)
op: 0=lsl (Usubmod+Usubzero), 1=lsr, 2=asr (Ubits, imms in base). 
proc a64BrLbl(a: var auto; base: uint32; lr: LabelRef; rel: int)
b/bl/b.cond/ldr-literal: Offset(B/BCOND) on a zero field. 
proc a64BrReg(a: var auto; base: uint32; rn: Register)
br/blr/ret reg: R(5). 
proc a64Cbx(a: var auto; base: uint32; rt: Register; lr: LabelRef)
cbz/cbnz: R(0) + Offset(BCOND). 
proc a64DupG(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd, rn: Register; is128: bool)
dup Vn.<arr>, Rn/Wn: R(0), R(5), Q bit. 
proc a64Fcmp0(a: var auto; base: uint32; rn: Register)
fcmp/fcmpe with #0.0: Rm field stays zero. 
proc a64FmovI(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd: Register; bits: uint32)
fmov S/D, #imm: Special FLOAT_IMMEDIATE at 13. 
proc a64Hlt(a: var auto; base: uint32; imm: int64)
hlt/svc: Ubits(5,16). 
proc a64LogicI(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd, rn: Register; imm: uint64;
               is64: bool)
AND/ORR/EOR (immediate): Special LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE. 
proc a64Mem9(a: var auto; base: uint32; rt, rn: Register; off: int64)
Pre/post-index ldr/str: Sbits(12,9), range -256..255. 
proc a64MemU(a: var auto; base: uint32; rt, rn: Register; off: int64; scale: int)
Unsigned-offset ldr/str: Uscaled(10,12,scale). Scale is 3 for 64-bit transfers, 2 for 32-bit (picked statically by the macro). 
proc a64MemX(a: var auto; base: uint32; rt, rn, rm: Register; ext, amt: int64;
             scale: int)
Register-offset ldr/str: ExtendsX(13) + S bit at 12. ext: 0=lsl, 1=sxtx (64-bit index); 2=sxtw, 4=uxtw (32-bit index). 
proc a64Misc(a: var auto; base: uint32)
proc a64Movi(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd: Register; imm: uint64; shift: int64;
             isH: bool; is128: bool)
movi Vn.4S/2S/H, #imm8 (, lsl): imm split over 9:5+18:16, shift/8 index at 14:13, Q bit at 30. H takes lsl #0/#8, S takes lsl #0/#8/#16/#24 (rs Ulist rows). 
proc a64MovI(a: var auto; rd: Register; imm: uint64; is64: bool)
Plain mov with immediate: MOVZ pattern only (rs WIDE_IMMEDIATE), i.e. a single 16-bit halfword slice. Anything else is an error (use mov.logical / explicit movz+movk for the rest). 
proc a64MoviD(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd: Register; imm: uint64; is128: bool)
movi Dn/2D, #stretched: STRETCHED_IMMEDIATE split over 9:5+18:16, Q bit at 30. 
proc a64MovInv(a: var auto; rd: Register; imm: uint64; is64: bool)
mov.inverted: MOVN pattern over the bitwise complement. 
proc a64MovLogic(a: var auto; rd: Register; imm: uint64; is64: bool)
mov.logical: ORR with a bitmask immediate (Rn=XZR baked in the base; the passed XZR ORs back to the same bits). 
proc a64MovWide(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd: Register; imm16: uint64;
                shiftAmt: int64; is64: bool)
movz/movn/movk: Ubits(5,16) + Ulist(21,0,16(,32,48)). 
proc a64Pair(a: var auto; base: uint32; rt1, rt2, rn: Register; off: int64;
             scale: int)
ldp/stp: Sscaled(15,7,scale), range +-64 scaled units (scale picked statically by the macro: 3 for X, 2 for W). 
proc a64Reloc(a: var auto; lr: LabelRef; rel: int)
Register a PC-relative fixup on the just-emitted word. fieldOffset=4, refOffset=4: value = target - instruction address. 
proc a64RR(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd, rm: Register)
R(0), R(16): mov (ORR), mvn. 
proc a64RRI12(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd, rn: Register; imm: int64;

proc a64RRn(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd, rn: Register)

proc a64RRRR(a: var auto; base: uint32; rd, rn, rm, ra: Register)

Shifted/rotated register: Rotates(22) + Ubits(10,6/5). shift: 0=lsl, 1=lsr, 2=asr, 3=ror.
